hero.title: One developer, one crow, three games.
hero.lede: Corvus Web Studio is the independent studio of Dylan Tuna, Senior Fullstack Engineer. Nine years of SaaS products in teams, and online games designed, built and drawn solo.
hero.crowAlt: Pixel art crow perched on a branch

dylan.title: Full-stack and AI, product side.
dylan.p1: Senior Fullstack Engineer based in Nancy, France. Since 2016, Dylan has been building SaaS in teams: ad tech, sports, creator tools. From the database schema to the interface, with a real taste for the details nobody notices when they work.
dylan.p2: On the side, he designs, builds and draws the studio's games on his own. AI is part of the daily toolkit: GPT-4 built into TweetHunter, then MCP, Skills and agents.

crow.title: Why Corvus?
crow.p1: No founding legend. The crow is Dylan's spirit animal, and the studio's name follows from it: corvus, in Latin.
crow.p2: It stays on as a signature: an animated logo, a few pixels, a quiet presence on every page.

precision.title: Precision
precision.text: From netcode to button, every detail gets attention, including the ones nobody notices.

sobriety.title: Restraint
sobriety.text: Few effects, nothing superfluous. The interface serves the project, never the other way round.

autonomy.title: Autonomy
autonomy.text: Design, development, art: one person carries the product from end to end.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.text: Patch notes, devlogs, open code whenever possible: the work is shown.

links.title: Follow the studio.
links.text: The code is on GitHub, trailers and devlogs on YouTube. A question? Write to the studio: reply within 24 h.
